name: Eagle Camp (Summer Eagle Camp)
description_short: A Christian day camp at Portsmouth Christian Academy in Dover, NH, running for eight weeks in summer. Each week has a theme, with games, crafts, outdoor time and field trips to local attractions. Campers are grouped as Eaglets (age 3 through incoming kindergarten) and Eagles (incoming grades 1–7).
activities: field trips to local attractions and community partners

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Summer Eagle Camp  - Portsmouth Christian Academy

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown. Its dates (June 15 – August 7, 2026) have already passed as of 2026-10-13. 2027 dates, prices and registration dates are not posted yet.
Registration dates (Feb 6 for current students, Feb 13 for future enrollees and referral campers, Feb 20 for open registration) are given without a year. They are assumed to be 2026.

The page calls this 'eight weeks' of themed programs but does not list each week separately or say whether you can sign up for single weeks. It is recorded here as one session covering the whole date range.
The page also mentions a separate Summer Kaleidoscope program (sports, fine arts, STEAM, tutoring). That program is not included in this listing.
